Description

Today for some reason randomly, the video player in our karaoke world instance (Mango Flange Karaoke) stopped working for me, but is still working for everyone else. Additionally, my face tracking completely stopped, and the VRCFT module stated "0 msgs/sec Incoming". I verified that untrusted URLs are enabled. I respawned, rejoined the instance, and updated as vrchat and rejoined said instance with no improvement, unfortunately. Restared VRCFT to see if it would pick up anything, but still 0 msgs/sec incoming.

Reproduction Steps

I legitimately did nothing. I was just standing in place, not messing with any menus. I assumed this was cause due to an issue on VRChat's end.

Details

- Category: Performance

- Frequency: Once
